channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US stocks near record high, oil falls as Trump claims Iran talks under way
item.description: Benchmark S&P500 approaches all-time peak as Washington, Tehran offer conflicting accounts of status of talks.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran denies US talks as Trump warns of ‘last chance’
item.description: US president says talks with Iran are under way, warning the negotiations are Tehran's 'last chance' to secure a deal.

item.title: Clergy members arrested while protesting at Senate office
item.description: Clergy members were arrested while protesting the Iran war and voting rights concerns at the Senate office.

item.title: Trump says talks with Iran are ‘last chance’ to forge a deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump said Iran has a "last chance" to reach a nuclear agreement.

item.title: US announces first two deaths from cyclospora outbreak in Michigan
item.description: Authorities in the Midwestern state of Michigan say that two people who died had underlying conditions.

item.title: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
item.description: Three children were killed when the drone crashed at a popular resort on the Black Sea.

item.title: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
item.description: Iran's remarks that there were no talks with the US prompts Donald Trump to issue a strong condemnation of its leadership.

item.title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
item.description: Fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes have left tankers facing an increasingly complex situation, analysts say.

item.title: US reports first two deaths linked to 'explosive diarrhoea' outbreak
item.description: The illness caused by parasitic infection that spreads through contaminated food or water is not generally life-threatening, health officials say.

item.title: Two workers killed in blast after re-entering quake-hit Japan mall on boss' order
item.description: The two women's employer has apologised for sending them back to Aeon Mall to secure cash.
